name: The Ad Nobody Asked For

pick.label: Pick a thing
pick.heading: Pick something nobody advertises and sell it
lead: Advertising agencies can make people want almost anything: trainers, perfume, a phone that is exactly like last year’s phone but more expensive.
So let’s see how good you are. Choose something that nobody ever advertises, because it’s free, boring, or something people actively try to avoid, and make an ad that makes us want it. *Badly.*
pick.hint: Or click one to choose it.
pick.note: This is not a real campaign brief, it’s just for a bit of fun. The more ridiculous the product, the more persuasive you have to be.

rows: Who are you talking to? Be specific: students, grandparents, tired parents, tourists…
What should people feel? Proud, hungry, jealous, nostalgic, a bit scared…
Your ad in 30 seconds: what happens, and what’s the music or sound?
One short line that people will remember.
TV, TikTok, a billboard, the U-Bahn, the side of a bus, somewhere unexpected…

values.audience: Students in Barcelona who think Berlin is all summer parties and open-air cinema.
values.feeling: Mysterious and a bit tragic, like the main character in a French film.
values.film: Black and white, slow motion. A man in a long coat waits for the M10 in the sleet. Nobody smiles. A pigeon walks past. A sad cello plays, and rain drips off the tram stop roof.
values.slogan: Berlin in February. Grey is the new black.
values.where: Huge posters in the metro in Barcelona, in July, when everyone is far too hot to argue.

yours.label: Your ad
yours.heading: Your idea
yours.lead: Fill it in on your own phone or laptop (it stays on your device), and be ready to tell the class about your ad in a few sentences.

rank.label: The ranking
rank.heading: Which ad wins?
rank.placeholder: The ad, e.g. Grey is the new black
